concerns.text: FR‑006 (CLI power analysis tool) is listed in the plan mapping table but does not appear in the feature specification; this is an over‑reach beyond the required functional requirements.
FR‑008 (bootstraps extraction on a representative set of papers) is present in the plan but is not defined in the spec; the plan adds functionality not requested.
FR‑009 (summarises dataset type and source categories) is included in the plan mapping but has no corresponding functional requirement in the spec.
FR‑012 (calculates download‑count weighting factor and runs sensitivity analysis) is present in the plan but is not part of the spec's functional requirements.
FR‑014 (writes ExtractionAuditReport JSON) is listed in the plan mapping table yet the spec does not define FR‑014; the spec only requires FR‑015 for the audit report.
SC‑007 (Weighting factor ≤ 1.5; dataset‑type distribution reported) appears in the plan but there is no corresponding success criterion in the specification.
SC‑008 (final audit report must include the ExtractionAuditReport JSON summary) is defined in the spec but is missing from the plan's mapping table; the plan does not address this success criterion.
